solution.summary: [Sample response] Run a fast, focused effort aimed at the board deadline: get the three department heads to agree on a short list of board metrics, reconcile those numbers manually where needed, and present them from one controlled report. Build the longer-term data platform as a second phase.
steps: Hold a working session with the three department heads to agree on the 10–15 board metrics and their definitions.
Measure the gap between the systems for each metric and pick a system of record for each.
Produce the board pack from a single controlled spreadsheet or report, with a documented reconciliation.
Assign a named owner for each metric before the board review.
After the review, scope phase two: an integrated reporting data store.

rationale.reasoning: Starting with a joint session gives each department a say in the definitions, so no one feels their numbers were overruled.
A manual reconciliation of a short metric list can be done well before the board review; a full integration could not.

set_aside.effect: The plan assumes the discrepancies are small enough to reconcile by hand; if they're large, the timeline is at risk.
The plan doesn't check whether the client's IT team can support phase two.
The manual board pack may be thrown away once phase two is built.
